name: DS Cluster D20: Treasury Auctions
description: Tests: common_treasury_auctions for 10Y Note, bid_to_cover trend, yield vs FRED Treasury10Y comparison.
source:
# =============================================================================
# DS CLUSTER D20: Treasury Auctions
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

# === 10Y NOTE AUCTION RESULTS ===
note10 = common_treasury_auctions(auction_type=TreasuryAuctionType.Note10Y)()
yield_10y = ffill(note10.high_yield)
btc_10y = ffill(note10.bid_to_cover)
btc_avg = ma(period=60, type=MAType.sma)(btc_10y)

# === FRED DAILY YIELD FOR COMPARISON ===
fred_10y_src = common_indicators(category=MacroEconomicsIndicator.Treasury10Y)()
fred_10y = ffill(fred_10y_src.result)

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title="10Y Auction Yield vs FRED Daily",
    category="Treasury",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Auction High Yield", color=Color.Red),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="FRED DGS10", color=Color.Blue)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(yield_10y, fred_10y))

xy_lines(
    title="Bid-to-Cover Ratio (10Y Note)",
    category="Treasury",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="BTC", color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="60d MA", color=Color.White)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=2.0, title="Weak"),
        ReferenceLine(value=2.5, title="Strong")
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(btc_10y, btc_avg))
